chapter: Band personalities, Duke's last years and the office
title: Duke and his watch
summary: Tizol put itching powder on a watch; Willard says Duke never wore a watch later.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Okay. Well .... I knew there was something I wanted to ask you. You mentioned back when you

were telling me about the stories of your practical jokes and you told me about asking Duke what time it was, and you said he wore a watch then, and in all the years I knew Duke, he would never wear a watch.
When did he stop wearing a watch? After you pulled that trick on him?

Well, I don't know, but I know when I pulled the trick, he had the watch then. So I don't know. Because in Baltimore one time, that's when I bought a diamond stone for Rose, and some of the boys bought diamonds from that jewelry store at the front of the theatre, there was a jewelry store, and he bought a big diamond there to give to his mother or something.
But you don't remember when he stopped wearing a watch?

Because the last 25 years of his life that I knew him, he never had a watch and wouldn't wear one, and people used to mention, you know, 'Duke, don't you have a watch?' and he would say, 'I don't want a watch; I don't like watches' -- but yet he always wanted to know what time it was.
He was superstitious about something, maybe.
